title: Desert moon
prompt: Sculptural rose-colored sandstone arches in a vast desert at blue hour, a large pale moon visible through the central arch, rippled dunes leading into the distance. Soft lavender sky, warm reflected light on stone, immaculate geological texture. Fine-art landscape photograph with a strong central silhouette and quiet negative space.

title: Aurora cabin
prompt: A tiny red timber cabin on the shore of a frozen Norwegian fjord, warm light glowing through its windows. Green aurora ribbons cross a star-filled sky above snow-covered mountains, reflected in a patch of unfrozen water. Cinematic night photography with crisp foreground snow and an intimate sense of scale.

title: Rainy flower shop
prompt: A charming flower shop on a narrow Paris street after rain, buckets of pink peonies and yellow tulips outside the door, a bicycle leaning beside the shop window. Warm interior light reflects on wet cobblestones, pale blue evening sky. Detailed watercolor illustration with delicate ink lines and a romantic atmosphere, no readable lettering.

title: Aviator
prompt: Portrait of a confident young adult female aviator wearing a weathered leather flight jacket and brass goggles resting on her head. A vintage propeller aircraft is softly visible behind her at sunrise. Natural expression, realistic skin, windblown hair, subtle amber rim light, cinematic medium-format photography, chest-up composition.

title: Violinist
prompt: An adult violinist in a dark velvet jacket playing beside a tall window in an old concert hall, golden afternoon light illuminating the violin and the musician's focused face. Dust floats in the light beam, ornate hall recedes into soft shadow. Intimate classical oil painting with rich textures and restrained colors.

title: Clockwork garden
prompt: A small friendly brass robot tending a rooftop garden full of sunflowers, holding a copper watering can, its round glass eyes reflecting the flowers. An old European city stretches into the distance under a clear morning sky. Charming detailed illustration, polished metal and organic leaves, warm optimistic mood.

title: Hummingbird
prompt: A ruby-throated hummingbird hovering beside a vivid orange hibiscus flower, iridescent green feathers sparkling in sunlight, wings suspended in a graceful arc. Lush tropical garden softly blurred behind it. High-speed macro wildlife photograph with jewel-like colors, fine feather detail and an elegant diagonal composition.

title: Glass octopus
prompt: A translucent blown-glass octopus sculpture with curling tentacles, cobalt blue and amber swirls suspended inside the glass, displayed on a pale stone pedestal. Soft side lighting casts intricate colored caustics on the surface. Museum-quality studio photograph, elegant sculptural form and pristine optical detail.

title: Embroidered landscape
prompt: A miniature mountain landscape embroidered on dark blue fabric, a winding river made of silver thread, alpine flowers in coral and yellow silk, a small rising sun stitched in gold. Close-up textile artwork, visible thread fibers and layered stitches, beautiful craftsmanship, balanced circular composition.

title: Celestial ocean
prompt: A decorative illustration of golden stars falling into a deep indigo ocean, stylized rolling waves edged with silver, a luminous crescent moon above the horizon. Art nouveau curves, fine engraved linework, elegant gold and midnight-blue palette, intricate details and a calm symmetrical composition.

title: Patisserie
prompt: Three exquisite individual pastries on a marble counter: a raspberry tart, a pistachio eclair and a glossy chocolate dome with a tiny gold leaf. The pastries are carefully spaced, a softly lit patisserie window behind them. High-end food photography, appetizing textures, precise detail and warm natural light.

title: Space station garden
prompt: The interior of an orbital space station with a lush botanical garden beneath an enormous curved window, Earth filling the view beyond the glass. A narrow white walkway crosses beds of green plants and pink flowers. Cinematic science-fiction architectural visualization, believable materials, clear depth and serene natural lighting.

title: Hot air balloons
prompt: Colorful hot air balloons rising over a valley of unusual rock formations at sunrise, one large striped balloon in the foreground and smaller balloons receding into soft mist. Warm sunlight skims the cliffs, the sky fades from apricot to blue. Stunning aerial travel photography with strong depth and natural detail.
